releaseNotes:
## Guest Inbox
- Fix Mark unread reverting after a refresh, and report mail-server read-state failures accurately.
- Fix Needs reply remaining active when a genuine later reply was mistaken for a duplicate.
- Show the sender's full Contacts name when available, with the email address underneath.
- Show folder hierarchy and paths in the Move to menu.

## Booking imports and Contacts
- Improve family imports using the current saved booking-request form, excluding unanswered examples and older quoted history.
- Preserve different surnames, child ages, unnamed guest counts, absent booking contacts and manual edits when importing again.
- Add an optional Recommended by field with an existing contact link or a typed name.

## Meal planning
- Keep recipe search visible in the planner and recipe list.
- Place recipes alongside the cook on wider screens while retaining the compact mobile layout.
- Edit existing meal-plan notes directly, with Save and Cancel; house and conference planners share the changes.

## Validation
- Focused parser, Contacts and mailbox regression tests, typecheck, ESLint and isolated production build.
- Browser checks use synthetic data and local mail services; no real emails are sent.
